title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for S_p - S_n as approximately 5.5 x 10^-3 A^(4/3).

title: Binding Energy Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the concept of binding energy and how it relates to the stability of nuclei.

title: Liquid-Drop Model
description: Important Criteria: The student must reference the liquid-drop model and its parameters that influence binding energy.

title: Neutron vs Proton Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the difference in energy required to remove protons versus neutrons in heavy nuclei.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the binding energy equations.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clarify the assumptions made regarding the equality of nuclear forces between nucleons.
